Welcome to the official YouTube channel for Seven Bridges Chiropractic. We are a wellness based chiropractic practice serving the historic San Marco neighborhood of Jacksonville, Florida. Our channel is designed for individuals who want to learn about chiropractic and how it can be your Bridge to Wellness! 

Dr. Dalton Tolliver, DC, is Board Certified and licensed in the state of Florida. She utilizes chiropractic, muscle release, and physiotherapy exercises to help her patients get back to their daily activities as soon as possible. 

Dr. Dalton is also the Team Chiropractor for the Orlando Rocket's box lacrosse team.
